description: $0.03 per call. Up to 25 newest UK tender notices from Find a Tender (feed=fts, default) or Contracts Finder (feed=cf), read live for each call. Returns title, buyer organisation, published and deadline dates, value and currency when stated, CPV codes, procedure, notice URL and next_cursor. No charge when nothing matches or the source fails. Use when: you need fresh UK tender notices to find bid opportunities or track buyers, with CPV codes and deadlines. Don't use when: you need contact people, award winners, full tender documents, or notices from outside the UK. Price: $0.03 per call over x402 (USDC on Base). Set sample:true for a sample at no charge.
